notes: Professional dark-mode redesign (v1.11.46, CSS/theme only — no logic, API, backend or feature change): one muted teal accent #5fb3a3 replaces the neon lime; deep slate surfaces (page #0f131c, chrome #131927, card #1a2030, raised #232b40, track #2e3852, input #0b0f17) with thin hairline borders and stronger chrome dividers; text 16.4:1 / text-2 11.7:1 / muted 7.8:1 on bg, all AA on every surface; status colours muted (success #5cbf7a, warning #e0a83f, danger #e06e6e, info #6ea8d8, orange #d98a4b); bundled Vazirmatn 33.0.3 + Inter variable fonts served locally (offline-safe, no CDN); done-state opacity removed (strikethrough + AA title colour instead); heatmap levels are solid AA fills; active nav uses the accent colour; primary/secondary/ghost/danger buttons distinguished with hover/active/focus/disabled states; table header on surface-3; placeholder + input error/success states; card padding unified on --card-pad/--card-pad-lg tokens; caption text 11px to 12px; light theme untouched (new tokens added with light values only).
